liturgicalName: The Nativity of the Lord (Christmas Day)
keyVerseDR: "And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us..." (Jn 1:14)

level1.title: Jesus Is Born!
level1.story: Jesus is born! He is God's Word who came to live with us. Jesus is the Light of the world!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What gift can you give Jesus?
level1.prayer: Baby Jesus, thank You for coming. Amen.

activity.title: My family at Christmas Mass
activity.intro: Draw your family at Mass, celebrating Jesus' birthday.
activity.prompt: My family at Christmas Mass, with the manger and Baby Jesus

level2.title: The Word Became Flesh
level2.story: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." Everything was made through Him. The Word is the light that shines in the darkness, and the darkness cannot overcome it. John the Baptist came to tell people about the light. At Christmas we celebrate that the Word became flesh and lived among us: Jesus, God's Son!
level2.keyLine: The Word was made flesh and dwelt among us.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'the Word was made flesh' mean?
How can you be a light to others?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Word made flesh, shine in my heart. Amen.

activity.title: LIGHT acrostic
activity.intro: Jesus is the light that shines in the darkness. Write a line for each letter.
